QUESTIONS

Is BlockForge a virus?
No. The game file was scanned with 68 desktop engines and none flagged it. You can open the full report and check the hash yourself.
Why does Windows say "Windows protected your PC"?
Windows SmartScreen shows this for new programs without a paid digital signature. A code-signing certificate costs money every year and I can't afford one right now. Click More info, then Run anyway.
Why is there no paid license or installer?
BlockForge is a free hobby project and I can't afford a commercial license. The launcher runs directly, without an installer.
Does it need other software?
No. It is a standalone program and only uses parts of Windows that are already installed.
Where are the games saved?
Each version is stored at %LOCALAPPDATA%\BlockForge\versions\<version>\BlockForge.exe. Paste the path into the File Explorer address bar to open it.
How do I uninstall a version?
Open the Versions page, select the installed version and click Uninstall Version. The launcher asks for confirmation first.
If Windows or your antivirus still blocks the file, use the VirusTotal report above and the hash check to confirm your download before running it.
